items.title: Yemen's Houthis reportedly seize strategic Red Sea port of Mokha
items.description: Mokha's capture would bring the Iran-backed group closer to controlling the Bab al-Mandab Strait waterway, a key shipping route.

items.title: Can Trump really pay $5,000 to every American adult?
items.description: Analysts question if the US president's election year offer is workable, legal or affordable.

items.title: Pilot warned Amazon cargo plane going too fast before deadly crash, data shows
items.description: One pilot told the other about the aircraft's "excessive speed" but received an uneven response even as alarms sounded.

items.title: Israel's Netanyahu to sue newspaper over claim UAE warned him of 7 October attack
items.description: The paper said it stood by its reporting, after publishing extracts from a book where the claim appears.

items.title: More than 20 children killed in DR Congo school fire
items.description: Officials say there was a stampede as they fled a fire that engulfed two schools in the eastern rebel-held city of Bukavu.

items.title: Man jailed after threatening to kill son's teacher in French village
items.description: The father had threatened to behead a female primary school teacher near Toulouse.

items.title: Coach crash kills several people in Swiss Alps
items.description: A coach carrying 48 Dutch passengers overturns, leaving several people dead.

items.title: Royal family rift after popular TV news presenter chosen to succeed Ugandan king
items.description: King Oyo's family say he left a will naming his young son as heir to the Tooro kingdom.

items.title: Apple's new boss starts with big gamble on £1,999 first folding iPhone
items.description: Apple showed off at an event the first major design change to the iPhone in almost 20 years.

items.title: Twenty-five dead after fire on cargo ship in eastern China
items.description: Of the 42 people on board, 17 were were evacuated, CCTV reports.

items.title: Iran war won't end until after crucial November elections, says Trump
items.description: The president also said oil prices won't come down until after the November races, claiming without evidence that Iran wants to impact the election.

items.title: Spanish intelligence warned of Ceuta mass crossing plans before surge
items.description: Declassified documents show Spanish and Moroccan authorities were alerted to social media calls for a mass migrant crossing the day before tens of thousands entered Ceuta.
